item.name: Authentication Service
item.description:
Authenticates based on provided credentials.
The API automatically identifies the login method based on the input fields provided.

**Note: **
All input fields (except method) are optional, but if you provide any field specific to a login type, you must
include all required fields for that type.
For example, providing username requires a password as well, or the login process will fail.

Authentication is not required by this service.

item.name: Autopilot Service
item.description:
Configure ad monitoring, review Autopilot events, and resume paused ads.

Authentication: bearer token or authenticated session cookie.

urlencoded.description: Required. Selects the API action.

JSON-encoded array of 1 to 100 objects containing ad_code and expected_version. Ad codes must be unique. Use version 0 for an ad without a policy.

Type: `string`. Required.

Validation schema:
```json
{
  "type": "string"
}
```

Autopilot mode: OFF, ALERT, or PAUSE. PAUSE requires consent; execution also depends on the server feature flags.

Type: `string`. Required.

Validation schema:
```json
{
  "enum": [
    "OFF",
    "ALERT",
    "PAUSE"
  ],
  "title": "AutopilotMode",
  "type": "string"
}
```

Result to monitor: clicks or joins. Joins include channel joins or bot starts, as reported by Telegram.

Type: `string`. Required.

Validation schema:
```json
{
  "enum": [
    "clicks",
    "joins"
  ],
  "title": "AutopilotGoal",
  "type": "string"
}
```

Target cost per result in coins, from 1 to 1,000,000,000. High-cost alerts use 1.5 times this target.

Type: `integer`. Required.

Validation schema:
```json
{
  "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
  "maximum": 1000000000,
  "type": "integer"
```
